title: Preparation of biotemplated Fe3O4 nanoparticles and evaluation of RF-induced heating efficiency for targeted hyperthermia

Y. Ranjith Kumar, Pragya Trivedi, Avijit Jana, D. Suman, M. Vasundhara
Successfully synthesized Fe3O4 nanoparticles using a bio-templating approach. Achieved controlled nanoparticle size and morphology. Investigated the effect of bio-template concentration on magnetic properties and heating performance.
